title: New test guards only the negative path — the positive invariant is unasserted in this diff
evidence:
+  // …and the reminder promise is gone.
+  html
+  |> string.contains("Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply")
+  |> should.be_false
detail: The new test asserts only hint absence for taken-over rows. Nothing here guards the positive path: if a refactor drops the ContactInitiated, False clause (catch-all first), every row loses the hint yet this test passes.
recommended_fix: Add a companion assertion that a non-taken-over ContactInitiated row (batches < 4) still renders the 'Next reminder' string, or keep an existing positive-path test in place.

detail: Docstring promises the invite and takeover events stay visible, but the test asserts only the takeover label chip and text. The invite entry (kind 'invitation_sent') is never asserted; a regression dropping the whole timeline for taken-over rows passes.

title: Absence assertion on one exact literal string fails silently on copy drift
evidence:
+  html
+  |> string.contains("Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply")
+  |> should.be_false
detail: Absence assertions on one exact string are brittle: copy drift ('in about 2 days', different punctuation) makes the test pass vacuously while the hint stays visible. It also assumes the renderer escapes ' as '.
recommended_fix: Assert via the shared copy constant rather than a literal, and add a positive control asserting the hint string renders for a non-taken-over row.

title: Fix's correctness rests on sweep SQL that is not in this diff
evidence:

detail: The fix rests on the premise that sweep_due_reference_calls.sql excludes taken-over rows (taken_over_at IS NULL), but that file is absent from this diff. If the sweep was never updated, reminders still fire while the UI hides the promise.
recommended_fix: Verify the sweep SQL (and its tests) actually keep taken_over_at IS NULL; if the exclusion exists only in this comment, add it and a regression test before merging.
